narr: Slow moving thunderstorms produced locally heavy rainfall across the Coastal Bend during the late morning hours. Street flooding occurred in Corpus Christi and Portland.
ev: Corpus Christi Emergency Manager reported the 4500 block of Baldwin Boulevard was flooded.
Corpus Christi Emergency Manager reported flooding at the intersection of South Padre Island Drive and Greenwood Drive.
Public reported video of street flooding with water up to the curbs in the west part of Portland.
